Built a playable 3D arcade soccer game in `index.html`, with a follow camera, boost and jump controls, an AI opponent, boost pickups, goals, and a 90-second match clock.

**Controls:** WASD or arrow keys to drive, Space to jump, Shift to boost, and R to reset kickoff. I used a 1v1 arena as a reasonable default. Verified the game loads and renders in Chromium, and checked the arena and kickoff screen.
